tool_args.rationale: All five paid observations show positive gain at H≤0.48, far short of the H=24.2 forecast. The slow-horizon probe samples near the expected reversal, where competing fits to the pilot data can predict materially different responses.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, the slow term mainly constrains its amplitude-to-timescale ratio, leaving the forecast at H=24.2 sensitive to how those parameters trade off.
Finer sampling is less directly informative than measuring near the expected reversal.
This measurement does not constrain the slow adaptation or the reversal.
